product_overview: Wateen is an Arabic-first on‑demand home nursing platform for Egypt that enables patients to request visits and nurses to accept and complete them via a secure API-driven backend. Core capabilities include user authentication, profile management, visit requesting and estimation, and payment webhook handling.
core_goals: Provide secure, phone/ID-based authentication and profile management for Patients and Nurses with JWT token support.
Enable a reliable visit lifecycle: price estimation, visit request creation, matching and completion, with clear state transitions and auditability.
Support fast geospatial matching and real-time operations (Redis/PostGIS backed) while keeping persistent records for compliance and analytics.
Offer a predictable, auditable pricing engine and payment integration (webhook mock for initial flows) with timezone-aware rules for Egypt (Africa/Cairo).
Maintain privacy and security best practices (Argon2 hashing, token blacklist on logout, environment-driven secrets) and be microservice-ready.

features.name: User Management
features.description: Register and authenticate Patients and Nurses, manage profiles (retrieve and update), obtain and refresh JWT tokens, and perform logout (token blacklist).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register/ with valid patient payload (phone_number, password, role=patient, required profile fields) -> Receive 201 Created with user id and role -> POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with phone_number and password -> Receive 200 with access and refresh tokens -> GET /api/v1/profile/ with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with user profile data -> PUT /api/v1/profile/ with updated profile fields and Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with updated profile

POST /api/v1/auth/register/ with existing phone_number or invalid validation fields -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error details -> POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with wrong credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh/ with an invalid or expired refresh token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> GET /api/v1/profile/ without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Visit Management
features.description: Request a new home nursing visit, obtain price estimates for planned visits, and accept payment events via webhook (mock). Visit creation and estimation are authenticated actions and integrate with the visits lifecycle state machine (PENDING, MATCHED, ACCEPTED, etc.).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access and refresh tokens -> POST /api/v1/visits/estimate/ with {lat, lng, service_id} and Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 200 with price_breakdown (base_price, distance_fee, night_fee, total) -> POST /api/v1/visits/request/ with {service_type, lat, lng, notes, vitals_consent} and Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 201 Created with visit id and status=PENDING -> POST /api/v1/visits/payments/webhook/mock/ with {visit_id, payment_status, gateway_ref} -> Receive 200 OK acknowledging webhook and update transaction status

POST /api/v1/visits/estimate/ with missing service_id or invalid coordinates and Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors -> POST /api/v1/visits/request/ without Authorization or with expired token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> POST /api/v1/visits/payments/webhook/mock/ with malformed payload (missing visit_id/payment_status) -> Receive 400 Bad Request
